concerns.text: SC-001 requires the *absolute percentage* change in MAE for the minority subset, but task T027 only computes the raw MAE difference (`MAE_skewed_minority - MAE_balanced_minority`). No task generates the percentage metric, leaving the success criterion uncovered.

SC-003 mandates reporting the *mean rank shift* of the top‑10 features. Tasks T038/T039 produce a rank‑shift CSV and validate it, but no task computes or records the mean rank shift value, so the specified success criterion is not satisfied.
